Fetch raw BMRB chemical shift data (no outlier filtering)

Source: R/chemical_shift_statistics.R
get_cs_from_bmrb_db.Rd

Mirrors `pybmrb.ChemicalShiftStatistics.get_data_from_bmrb()`.

get_cs_from_bmrb_db(
  residue = "*",
  atom = "*",
  list_of_atoms = NULL,
  ambiguity = "*",
  ph_min = NULL,
  ph_max = NULL,
  t_min = NULL,
  t_max = NULL,
  standard_amino_acids = TRUE,
  database = "macromolecules"
)

Arguments

residue

Residue in IUPAC 3-letter format (e.g. "ALA"). "*" = any.

atom

Atom name (e.g. "CA", "HB*"). "*" = any.

list_of_atoms

Optional "RES-ATOM" vector, e.g. `c("ALA-CB","GLY-CA")`.

ambiguity

Ambiguity code filter ("*" = no filter; 1 = unambiguous).

ph_min, ph_max

pH range filter (optional).

t_min, t_max

Temperature range in Kelvin (optional).

standard_amino_acids

Restrict to standard amino acids. Default TRUE.

database

"macromolecules" (default) or "metabolomics".

Value

A data.frame of raw chemical shift records.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  df  <- get_cs_from_bmrb_db("ALA", "CB")
  df2 <- get_cs_from_bmrb_db(list_of_atoms = c("ALA-CB","GLY-CA"))
} # }
